extracted.intended_audience: Members of the public and stakeholders wishing to submit comments to the FAA docket (FAA-2024-2531) on the Part 141 Modernization Industry Recommendations Report
extracted.subtask_description: Submitting public comments to the Federal Aviation Administration on the Part 141 Modernization Industry Recommendations Report, following the procedural requirements (deadline, identification, submission methods) and understanding the public posting/privacy practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments close / timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received no later than May 11, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This document has a comment period that ends in 1 day (05/11/2026). Submit by the specified close date to be considered. The Published Document and the 'Comments Close' date are displayed in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods of submission (acceptable channels)
rubrics_metrics.description: Send comments identified by docket number FAA-2024-2531 using any of the following methods: Federal eRulemaking Portal (www.regulations.gov), Mail, Hand Delivery or Courier, Fax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal eRulemaking Portal: go to www.regulations.gov and follow the online instructions. Mail: send to Docket Operations, M-30; U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE, Room W12-140, Washington, DC 20590-0001. Hand Delivery/Courier: take to Docket Operations in Room W12-140 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays. Fax: fax comments to Docket Operations at (202) 493-2251.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification by docket number
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments should be identified by docket number FAA-2024-2531.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the docket number on submissions so they are associated with Docket No. FAA-2024-2531; Regulations.gov and the FederalRegister.gov docket display use the agency dockets published with the document to link related documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public posting and privacy of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: DOT posts comments, without edit, including any personal information the commenter provides, to www.regulations.gov, in accordance with 5 U.S.C. 553(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies review all submissions and may choose to redact, or withhold, certain submissions (or portions thereof). Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them. See the system of records notice (DOT/ALL-14 FDMS) for details: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-01-17/pdf/E8-785.pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to docket and supporting documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Background documents or comments received may be read at www.regulations.gov at any time; follow the online instructions for accessing the docket or go to the Docket Operations in person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FederalRegister.gov retrieves relevant information about the document from Regulations.gov to provide additional context, but that information is not part of the official Federal Register document. The notice lists related docket documents and indicates whether supporting documents are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report status and scope of solicitation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Part 141 Modernization Industry Recommendations Report constitutes an industry-based proposal to FAA and is not part of a rulemaking action, and therefore is not subject to requirements for a public comment period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite not being a formal rulemaking document, the FAA will afford all interested parties the opportunity to provide input on the report in recognition of stakeholder participation and the inclusive approach taken during public meetings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of official PDF / legal notice caution
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays an XML rendition that is not an official legal edition; use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Until the Administrative Committee of the Federal Register (ACFR) grants it official status, the XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts. Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication (see 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507). Verify contents against the official edition for legal research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document drafting headings (what the notice contains)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings may contain: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends or relates to; the agency docket number; the RIN.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The table of contents and headings are navigational tools processed from the legal text. For more details on drafting, see the Document Drafting Handbook referenced in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact Lyndsay Carlson with the Part 141 Modernization Initiative Team for further information (phone and email provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided telephone (202) 267-1100 or email 9-AFS-Modernization-Part141-Comments@faa.gov for questions about the report or comment submission process.
